issue.title: [teamd][warmreboot] teamd fails to restore PortChannel state sporadically after warm reboot

failure.body:
[teamd.txt](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/files/3757377/teamd.txt)

**Description**

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. sudo warm-reboot -v
2. repeat until use see issue with LAG flapping
3. zgrep ERR teamd.log

Part of teamd log
```
Oct 22 <IPV6>.827944 arc-switch1004 ERR teamd#teamd_PortChannel0002[36]: Ethernet116: Failed to find "enabled" option.
Oct 22 <IPV6>.827984 arc-switch1004 ERR teamd#teamd_PortChannel0002[36]: get_ifinfo_list: check_call_change_handers failed
Oct 22 <IPV6>.828018 arc-switch1004 ERR teamd#teamd_PortChannel0002[36]: Failed to get interface information list.
Oct 22 <IPV6>.828056 arc-switch1004 ERR teamd#teamd_PortChannel0002[36]: Failed to refresh interface information list.
Oct 22 <IPV6>.828096 arc-switch1004 ERR teamd#teamd_PortChannel0002[36]: Ethernet116: Team refresh failed.
Oct 22 <IPV6>.829959 arc-switch1004 ERR teamd#teamd_PortChannel0002[36]: Failed to init port priv.
Oct 22 <IPV6>.833389 arc-switch1004 ERR teamd#teamd_PortChannel0002[36]: ioctl SIOCDELMULTI failed.
Oct 22 <IPV6>.839081 arc-switch1004 ERR teamd#teamd_PortChannel0002[36]: Port with interface index "76" is not part of this device.
```

**Describe the results you received:**

LAG flaps sometimes after warm reboot

**Describe the results you expected:**

teamd restores LAG

**Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):**

    **Output of `show version`:**


resolution.title: teamd: fix possible race in master ifname callback
resolution.description:
**- What I did**
Ported a [fix](https://github.com/jpirko/libteam/commit/c7237377dead39ae4a711297203bacf7edb9fa41) from libteam master to our master.
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/4070
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/3649

**- How I did it**
Applied patch https://github.com/jpirko/libteam/commit/c7237377dead39ae4a711297203bacf7edb9fa41 from upstream.

**- How to verify it**
Build image for your DUT and warm-reboot your DUT 10 times. Check that all PortChannels are up and no error messages in teamd.log
